semantics.how: Computes vertices with points, draws fill and stroke via facetPath inside a sized SVG and overlays children in a centred container
semantics.what: Renders a faceted shape as SVG with children centred on top
semantics.when: Used wherever the design system needs a chamfered or tagged outline
semantics.where: Design-system viz primitive: faceted SVG shapes
semantics.why: Keeps the outline unbroken on diagonal edges, unlike CSS borders with clip-path

semantics.how: For each vertex trims r back along both adjacent edges and joins them with a quadratic curve through the vertex
semantics.what: Builds an SVG path string for a polygon with rounded vertices
semantics.when: Called by Facet and PolyNode when drawing a shape
semantics.where: Design-system viz primitive: faceted SVG shapes
semantics.why: SVG paths round corners cleanly where a CSS border under clip-path would break on diagonals

semantics.how: Switches on the shape name and emits polygon vertices, converting pixel chamfer and tag cuts into unit space using the box width and height
semantics.what: Returns the unit-space vertex list for a named facet shape
semantics.when: Called by Facet before building its path
semantics.where: Design-system viz primitive: faceted SVG shapes
semantics.why: Chamfer cuts are specified in pixels so they need the box size to stay visually constant
